text.en: Short verses in praise of three great Tamil kings.

Muthollayiram is an old Tamil poetic work, now available only in parts, in which each of the three crowned kings, Chera, Chola and Pandya, is praised in about nine hundred verses. The textbook gives a memorisation poem from it.
The verses praise the valour and generosity of the kings and describe imaginative scenes.
Terms: மூவேந்தர் (the three kings), சேரன், சோழன், பாண்டியன் and மனப்பாடம்.
